h1: Black Rock City travel, stays & events guide
heroText: Black Rock City is the temporary city of the Burning Man event in the Black Rock Desert, laid out around the Man, the Temple, Center Camp and the Esplanade. It became a real city plan in 1997, with labelled streets, zoning and vehicle registration, and the Temple has been a fixture since 2000. Beyond the street grid lies the open Deep Playa.

history.text: Sculptor Mary Grauberger, a friend of Larry Harvey's girlfriend, Janet Lohr, held solstice bonfire gatherings on Baker Beach for several years before 1986, some of which Harvey attended.
1996 was the first year a formal partnership was created to own the name "Burning Man" and was also the last year the event was held in the middle of the Black Rock Desert with no fence around it.
Black Rock City truly became a city in 1997, with formal, labeled streets, zoning, and registration for vehicles and theme camps.
2000 saw the introduction of the Temple as a fixture on the playa, and it has grown to be easily as important as the Man.
On August 26, it was reported that tickets remained unsold for the event for the first time since 2011.
In 2015, organizers established a new area known as the "Deep Playa Music Zone" to serve as a new host for art cars featuring live DJs.
On September 3, 2017, a 41-year-old man, Aaron Joel Mitchell, fought his way past a safety cordon of volunteers and firefighters and threw himself into the flames of the Man.
